name: SpendGate
description: Policy Copilot and spending turnstile for financial AI agents on Base (USDC). Owner states rules in natural language; SpendGate drafts policy and gates every spend — ALLOW / DENY / ESCALATE. AgentKit signs only after ALLOW. Non-custodial.

openserv.invoke: x402 payWorkflow with { prompt } — no end-user API keys

skills.description: Draft a MandatePolicy from natural language with conflicts, assumptions, and questions. Does not store until apply.
Revise a stored policy from owner feedback; returns a new draft.
Persist an accepted MandatePolicy under a policyId.
Deterministic allow | deny | escalate for a proposed spend. No transaction.
Explain a gate result and suggest mandate edits. Never overrides the verdict.
Evaluate then AgentKit USDC transfer only on ALLOW (or escalate + humanApproved).

invariants: Allow/deny/escalate is deterministic code — never LLM judgment
SpendGate does not custody user funds or private keys
End users do not configure SERV_API_KEY or CDP secrets — the host does
